instructions.name: batch_close_attestation_accounts

types.name: Attestation
docs: Attestation account to track consumed attestations
each consumed attestation is stored in its own account

types.name: GMTokenDeployed
docs: Event emitted when a GM Token is deployed
- gm_token: The public key of the deployed GM Token

types.name: GMTokenManagerState
docs: GM Token Manager State account - tracks global state for GM Token operations

fields.name: attestation_signer_secp
docs: Ethereum address (20 bytes) for secp256k1 signature verification
Used to verify attestation signatures for buy/sell operations

fields.name: trading_hours_offset
docs: Trading hours offset from UTC in seconds
Positive values are east of UTC, negative values are west of UTC

types.name: GMTokenMintingPaused
docs: Event emitted when minting for a GM Token is paused or unpaused
- is_paused: Boolean indicating if minting/redemptions are paused
- token: The address of the GM Token
- pauser: The address of the operator who performed the pause/unpause action

types.name: GMTokenPaused
docs: Event emitted when a GM Token is paused/unpaused at the mint-level
- is_paused: Boolean indicating whether the token is paused
- token: The address of the GM Token
- pauser: The address of the operator who performed the pause/unpaused action

types.name: GMTokenRedemptionPaused
docs: Event emitted redemptions for a GM Token are paused or unpaused
- is_paused: Boolean indicating if redemptions are paused
- token: The address of the GM Token
- pauser: The address of the operator who performed the pause/unpause action

types.name: OndoUser
docs: OndoUser state account - tracks user-specific data for a GM Token

types.name: OracleSanityCheck
docs: OracleSanityCheck state account - tracks sanity check parameters for a specific mint

types.name: RateLimitTokenSet
docs: Event emitted when a rate limit is set for a token
- token: The public key of the token for which the rate limit is set
- limit_window: The time window for the rate limit

types.name: RateLimitUserSet
docs: Event emitted when a rate limit is set for a user
- user: The public key of the user for whom the rate limit is set

types.name: RoleGranted
docs: Event emitted when a role is granted to a user
- role: The role that was granted
- grantee: The public key of the user who was granted the role
- granter: The public key of the user who granted the role

types.name: RoleRevoked
docs: Event emitted when a role is revoked from a user
- role: The role that was revoked
- grantee: The public key of the user who had the role revoked
- revoker: The public key of the user who revoked the role

types.name: Roles
docs: Roles state account - tracks role assignments for addresses

types.name: SanityCheckSet
docs: Event emitted when a sanity check is set for a mint
- mint: The public key of the mint for which the sanity check is set
- allowed_deviation_bps: The allowed deviation in basis points
- max_time_delay: The maximum time delay for the sanity check

types.name: SanityCheckUpdated
docs: Event emitted when a sanity check is updated for a mint
- mint: The public key of the mint for which the sanity check is updated
- allowed_deviation_bps: The allowed deviation in basis points (optional)
- max_time_delay: The maximum time delay for the sanity check (optional)

types.name: TokenFactoryPaused
docs: Event emitted when the Token Factory is paused or unpaused
- is_paused: Boolean indicating if the Token Factory is paused
- pauser: The address of the operator who performed the pause/unpause action

types.name: TokenLimit
docs: TokenLimit state account - tracks global token limit parameters for a specific GM Token

types.name: TokenManagerMintingPaused
docs: Event emitted when GM Token minting is globally paused or unpaused
- is_paused: Boolean indicating if the minting is globally paused
- pauser: The address of the user who performed the pause/unpause action

types.name: TokenManagerRedemptionPaused
docs: Event emitted when GM Token redemptions are globally paused or unpaused
- is_paused: Boolean indicating if redemptions are globally paused
- pauser: The address of the operator who performed the pause/unpause action

types.name: TokensRetrieved
docs: Event emitted when tokens are retrieved (withdrawn) from a vault by an admin
- token: The public key of the token mint being withdrawn
- to: The destination address receiving the tokens
- amount: The amount of tokens withdrawn
- authority: The public key of the admin who executed the withdrawal

types.name: TradeExecuted
docs: Event emitted when a trade is executed
- execution_id: The unique identifier of the trade execution

types.name: USDonManagerState
docs: USDonManagerState state account - tracks global configuration for the USDon stablecoin system

types.name: UserAddedToWhitelist
docs: Event emitted when a user is added to the whitelist
- user: The public key of the user being added to the whitelist
- added_by: The public key of the admin who added the user to the whitelist

types.name: UserRemovedFromWhitelist
docs: Event emitted when a user is removed from the whitelist
- user: The public key of the user being removed from the whitelist
- removed_by: The public key of the admin who removed the user from the whitelist

types.name: Whitelist
docs: Used as a marker account - presence of the account indicates whitelisting.
